title: Is a Private Boat a Good Idea for a Hen Party in Madeira?
description: Yes, for a hen group of five or fewer: the whole boat is yours, with local wine, poncha and beer, photos and 360 video. It is a small boat, not a party boat.
heroAlt: Drone view of five friends raising glasses on the deck of a white boat at sunset

images.prompt: Drone photo from directly above and slightly behind, at golden hour off the south coast of Madeira near Cabo Girão. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy sits on calm deep blue water with a soft wake. Five small figures on the deck, seen from above, raise glasses together, one wearing a white sash. Faces not visible at this height. Warm low sunlight, long soft shadows, true colours, the base of the dark cliff at the edge of the frame.
images.alt: Drone view of five friends raising glasses on the deck of a white boat at sunset

images.prompt: Close detail on a boat seat at sunset: five glasses of rosé and poncha on a small tray, a white satin sash folded beside them, warm golden light, blurred Madeira coastline behind, no faces.
images.alt: Glasses of wine and poncha beside a folded white sash on a boat seat

images.prompt: From the water at dusk: a white motor boat returning towards Funchal, the city lights coming on across the hillside behind, deep blue sky with the last orange glow on the horizon, small silhouettes on deck.
images.alt: Boat returning to Funchal at dusk as the city lights come on behind it
